title: Line sketch: Vortex of Swirls
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: abstract composition depicts large, dynamic spiral forms resembling twin vortexes or floral bursts, rendered with bold, sweeping. The composition balances two dominant circular motifs on either side against a light background, with smaller swirling details anchoring the lower left. Visible textured strokes suggest fluid, gestural application emphasizing movement and rhythm (derived from painting #6).
